subject: Rebilling pathway: Slatech renewal -> marketplace billing (next steps)
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maya Ramos <m.ramos@slatech.com>; procurement@slatech.com
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-11-30T15:08:00Z
Subject: Slatech renewal — marketplace rebilling option & checklist

Hi Maya / Slatech procurement team,

Thanks for the productive renewal call yesterday. As discussed, we have a clean path to move your upcoming Redwood subscription from direct invoicing to the AWS Marketplace listing. This will simplify procurement for Slatech long-term and unlock co-sell incentives on our side.

High-level proposal:
- Convert the existing subscription to an equivalent Marketplace SKU at next renewal date (2027-01-15)
- Issue a marketplace amendment (draft attached) that maps current entitlements to the Marketplace product code
- Slatech to submit a PO referencing the Marketplace amendment; Redwood will accept via standard DocuSign flow

Immediate asks from our side so we can finalize the amendment:
1) Confirm the legal entity and billing address to appear on the Marketplace invoice
2) Confirm whether Slatech requires a CA/PO number on the DocuSign envelope
3) Any required SLA exception or custom clause (Marking below) — if yes, send over the language or a redline

I attached a draft amendment and an internal checklist. I’ve looped Lauren to confirm pricing math for the marketplace SKU mapping. I’ll follow up with a DocuSign link once we have confirmation on the billing entity and PO details.

Best,
Irene Choi
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachment: Slatech_Marketplace_Amendment_draft.pdf (PDF, 238KB)
From: Maya Ramos <m.ramos@slatech.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@slatech.com
Date: 2026-12-01T09:22:00Z
Subject: Re: Slatech renewal — marketplace rebilling option & checklist

Thanks, Irene — this looks promising. A few quick clarifications from procurement: 

- Legal entity: Slatech Incorporated (Slatech Inc.)
- Billing address: 1107 Harbor Drive, Suite 600, San Jose, CA 95134
- We do want the PO number present on the DocuSign envelope. Use PO: SLT-PO-9831

On SLAs: our security/compliance team asked if we could preserve the 99.9% latency SLA we have in the current contract. I see an SLA-exception document noted in your email — can you confirm that will be included? If there are redlines, procurement will send them back via tracked changes.

Also: timeline question — how long after we sign will Redwood switch billing to Marketplace so our internal FinOps team can plan the accounting cutover?

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

— Maya Ramos
Director, Procurement | Slatech

Team — forwarding Slatech's answers; we need to finalize: pricing parity and SLA exception language, and confirm cutover timeline.

What I need from you both:
- Lauren: map Slatech’s existing tier to the Marketplace SKU and confirm final price including marketplace fees, so I can put that in the amendment.
- Markus: confirm whether we can accept PO SLT-PO-9831 on DocuSign and if finance needs any additional invoice metadata for marketplace billing.
- Grace: FYI on the SLA ask — can you confirm whether the existing 99.9% latency SLA is compatible with Marketplace terms or whether we need an exception addendum?

Slack or quick call ok today — otherwise please reply by EOD 12/03 so I can respond to Slatech.

Thanks,
Irene

Subject: Re: Fwd: Slatech renewal — marketplace rebilling option & checklist

Irene — pricing mapped below. I used the current Slatech invoice (Nov 2026) as the baseline and applied our marketplace uplift assumptions.

- Current monthly recurring spend: $87,500
- Marketplace SKU equivalence (mkt-sku-XL): list price $93,000/month
- Expected marketplace transaction/commission delta: ~3.2% (absorbed by Redwood)
- Effective pass-through to Slatech (no increase to Slatech list price) — final billed rate will be identical to current net spend if we apply vendor credit for the delta per negotiated co-sell playbook.

Action items:
- I will attach a numeric conversion worksheet and mark the amendment to show parity mapping.
- Markus: if finance needs any additional line items (VAT, tax jurisdiction, or special invoice fields), flag here.

Timeline note: once amendment is fully signed via DocuSign and the PO is uploaded, the Marketplace SKU can go live on the next billing cycle, typically within 7–10 business days (to allow marketplace enrollment, entitlement sync, and invoice routing tests). If Slatech needs the cutover to be exactly on 2027-01-15 we can coordinate with marketplace ops to meet that date — but we should confirm signing no later than 2026-12-29.

Lauren Bishop
Director, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com

Attached: Slatech_PO_2026-12.pdf

On SLA: our legal has one small ask to preserve the 99.9% latency bullet and to insert a clause clarifying incident notification windows. They’ll send a redline to SLA-exception-request.docx by EOD 12/09.

Please proceed with DocuSign when you have the amendment updated to reference PO SLT-PO-9831.

— Maya

Subject: Slatech — DocuSign sent + marketplace cutover checklist

Hi Maya / procurement team,

We’ve updated the amendment to include the PO (SLT-PO-9831) and added a short SLA exception clause per your note — DocuSign envelope sent: https://www.docusign.com/en/link/abc123-slatech-amendment

What happens next (cutover checklist):
1) Slatech signs the DocuSign amendment (please sign and return by 2026-12-29 to meet the 2027-01-15 cutover)
2) Redwood marketplace ops will validate entitlement sync and billing metadata (7–10 business days post-signature)
3) Finance will switch invoice routing to AWS Marketplace; Slatech will receive the first marketplace invoice on the next billing cycle
4) We will schedule a quick ops call (30 min) to validate invoice fields and test the first sample invoice — proposed window 2027-01-05 to 2027-01-07

Attachments included in the envelope: Slatech_Marketplace_Amendment_draft.pdf (updated), SLA-exception-request.docx (placeholder for redlines).

If everything looks good, I’ll keep the DocuSign reminder cadence at 3 days and 1 week. Happy to jump on a call if procurement/legal want to walk through the amendment.

Thanks again — looking forward to getting Slatech onto Marketplace cleanly.

Best,
Irene Choi
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachment (sent via DocuSign): Slatech_Marketplace_Amendment_draft.pdf, SLA-exception-request.docx
